method: Second pass through public department pages, original event pages, architect documentation and explicit document links. Known failed FIS endpoints were not retried. No email or access request was sent.

sources.title: Backfill Opportunities | Social Sciences Building
sources.finding: Actual divided floor plan visually reviewed at native resolution and nearest-neighbor magnification. Current target labels 333 and 353 are not reliably legible. Typical Floor does not establish L3. Whole-building 84000 GSF cannot calibrate this floor.
Lists seminar/conference rooms 104, 333 and 353; no floor drawing located in the 22-page extracted text.
Places Political Science on the third floor and the lunch group in room 333, but gives no interior boundary.
Department emergency directions identify some second-floor locations but do not provide a numbered third-floor drawing.

decision: Preserve existing geometry and leave 333/353 unplaced. A higher-resolution, specifically identified third-floor source is needed.
